MRT.note: Only a municipal taxpayer census, not a population census or household survey.
Document states nothing on office connections.

facts.fact: The mayor of Ksar says the El Mouhassil programme runs a full taxpayer census whose data go into the municipal database, with the commune's office then applying council decisions on the municipal tax, set on 14 criteria per taxpayer.
The mayor says the census data are entered in the Ksar municipal database, managed by an office the commune created.

El Mouhassil was developed in cooperation between Mauritania's Ministry of the Interior and Decentralisation and German cooperation, and adopted by the commune of Ksar with several other municipalities cooperating.

systems.owner: Ministry of the Interior and Decentralisation
